sources.authors: Ronald Fagin; Amnon Lotem; Moni Naor
sources.novelty_effect: Strongly anticipates the generic sum-of-queue-heads top-1 stopping architecture in the original exact LS-GRAND theorem.
sources.technical_relevance: Threshold Algorithm: sorted access to multiple per-object score lists, random access to complete scores, and stopping when the best complete object score exceeds the monotone aggregate of current list thresholds.
sources.title: Optimal Aggregation Algorithms for Middleware

sources.authors: L. R. Bahl; J. Cocke; F. Jelinek; J. Raviv
sources.novelty_effect: Latent-state marginalization is a foundational known principle.
sources.technical_relevance: Exact posterior marginalization over hidden Markov states/transitions; linear-code decoding is explicitly a special case.
sources.title: Optimal Decoding of Linear Codes for Minimizing Symbol Error Rate

sources.authors: F. R. Kschischang; B. J. Frey; H.-A. Loeliger
sources.novelty_effect: Many-to-one hidden-state aggregation is not a new generic inference abstraction.
sources.technical_relevance: Generic exact or approximate marginal-function computation on factor graphs; forward-backward and decoding are special cases.
sources.title: Factor Graphs and the Sum-Product Algorithm

sources.authors: Ken R. Duffy; Jiange Li; Muriel Médard
sources.identifier: arXiv:1802.07010; IEEE Transactions on Information Theory 2019
sources.novelty_effect: The code-agnostic membership-query architecture and first-valid paradigm are established GRAND foundations.
sources.technical_relevance: Likelihood-ordered disturbance guessing with arbitrary codebook membership; first valid hit is ML in the one-implied-disturbance additive setting.
sources.title: Capacity-achieving Guessing Random Additive Noise Decoding

sources.authors: Ken R. Duffy; Wei An; Muriel Médard
sources.novelty_effect: Soft reliability ordering and practical first-hit code-agnostic decoding are established.
sources.technical_relevance: Reliability-ordered approximate soft GRAND for arbitrary moderate-redundancy codes.
sources.title: Ordered Reliability Bits Guessing Random Additive Noise Decoding

sources.novelty_effect: Broad claims such as first GRAND for finite-state memory are not defensible.
sources.technical_relevance: Noise guessing for unknown finite-state additive channels.
sources.title: Universal Decoding over Finite-State Additive Channels via Noise Guessing

sources.novelty_effect: Exact likelihood ordering for non-memoryless channels is already an active GRAND direction.
sources.technical_relevance: Exact SGRAND-ISI and practical approximations for a channel with memory.
sources.title: GRAND for Gaussian Intersymbol Interference Channels

sources.novelty_effect: Conditional state/path enumeration alone is not a sufficient novelty claim.
sources.technical_relevance: Trellis/dynamic-programming exact ordering and best-first enumeration for correlated Gaussian noise.
sources.title: Low-Pathwidth GRAND: Exact Likelihood-Ordered Enumeration for BPSK Transmission over Correlated Gaussian Noise

sources.authors: Mustafa Cemil Coşkun; Gianluigi Liva; Johan Östman; Giuseppe Durisi
sources.novelty_effect: List construction followed by channel/state-marginal rescoring is an established workflow.
sources.technical_relevance: Constructs a short-code list and applies a complete noncoherent metric to the list for final decision.
sources.title: Low-Complexity Joint Channel Estimation and List Decoding of Short Codes

sources.novelty_effect: Joint coding/phase-slip inference is not new.
sources.technical_relevance: Factor-graph Bayesian inference jointly handles LDPC constraints and strong phase noise, including phase slips.
sources.title: Efficient Iterative Decoding of LDPC in the Presence of Strong Phase Noise

sources.authors: Marvin Geiselhart; Marc Gauger; Felix Krieg; Jannis Clausius; Stephan ten Brink
sources.novelty_effect: Code/constellation symmetry and orbit considerations are established, although the exact algebraic screening used here may remain a useful specialization.
sources.technical_relevance: Uses code automorphisms/frozen-bit design to resolve QPSK/QAM phase ambiguities without pilots.
sources.title: Phase-Equivariant Polar Coded Modulation

sources.authors: Chin-Hung Chen; Ivana Nikoloska; Wim J. van Houtum; Yan Wu; Alex Alvarado
sources.novelty_effect: Finite phase-candidate generation and decoder-aided model selection/event-triggering are known architectural patterns.
sources.technical_relevance: Generates a finite set of PSK-symmetry candidate models and uses decoder evidence to select the most likely model; invoked only when needed.
sources.title: Phase-Aware Code-Aided EM Algorithm for Blind Channel Estimation in PSK-Modulated OFDM

sources.authors: Bin Li; Hui Shen; David Tse
sources.novelty_effect: Adaptive list enlargement triggered by code validity is known; novelty must lie in the latent-cause ordering and specific ambiguity rule.
sources.technical_relevance: Iteratively increases list size until a code-validity condition passes.
sources.title: An Adaptive Successive Cancellation List Decoder for Polar Codes with Cyclic Redundancy Check

sources.novelty_effect: Very close prior to code-aided selection among phase rotations and orbit-safety concepts; creates material patent-proximity risk.
sources.technical_relevance: Applies parallel phase rotations and FEC-code/MLSE evidence to recover absolute carrier phase; exploits the fact that wrong rotations need not map to valid codewords.
sources.title: Use of Parity-Check Coding for Carrier-Phase Estimation in an Optical Transport System

sources.novelty_effect: Phase-slip-aware FEC coding/decoding is established and patented.
sources.technical_relevance: Special LDPC coding/decoding constructions for phase-slip channels and persistent bit inversions.
sources.title: LDPC Coding and Decoding for Channels with Phase Slip

sources.novelty_effect: The physical use case and discrete-rotation correction problem are mature prior art.
sources.technical_relevance: Addresses coherent-receiver cycle slips caused by constellation rotational symmetry and persistent post-slip errors.
sources.title: Cycle Slip Compensation in a Coherent Receiver

sources.authors: Warren J. Gross; Syed Mohsin Abbas; Thibaud Tonnellier
sources.novelty_effect: Any implementation or hardware claim must account for the existing GRAND IP landscape.
sources.technical_relevance: Hardware architecture for candidate error-pattern generation and codebook membership evaluation.
sources.title: Architecture for Guessing Random Additive Noise Decoding (GRAND)

sources.novelty_effect: Freedom-to-operate cannot be inferred from an academic novelty screen.
sources.technical_relevance: Universal GRAND decoder intellectual-property family.
sources.title: Universal Guessing Random Additive Noise Decoding (GRAND) Decoder

sources.novelty_effect: Broad modulation-aware GRAND claims are unsafe.
sources.technical_relevance: Extends GRAND-style candidate generation and membership testing to higher-order constellations.
sources.title: Guessing Random Additive Noise Decoding for Higher Modulation Constellations

sources.novelty_effect: Broad first-of-kind wording must be avoided and patent review is required.
sources.technical_relevance: Documents a wide GRAND portfolio including memory, symbol reliability, demodulation, fading, joint detection, correlation, and hardware.
sources.title: GRAND Papers

sources.novelty_effect: The optical phase-slip anchor is established technology, not itself a novelty.
sources.technical_relevance: Parallel carrier-phase estimation and explicit ±90-degree cycle-slip detection/correction in coherent QPSK systems.
sources.title: Cycle Slip Reduction in Coherent Optical Communications

sources.novelty_effect: Rotational code suitability is longstanding prior art.
sources.technical_relevance: Coding methods designed to recover from phase ambiguities/rotations without catastrophic FEC behavior.
sources.title: Rotationally Invariant Trellis Coding Incorporating Transparent Binary Convolutional Codes

sources.authors: Basak Ozaydin; Muriel Médard; Ken R. Duffy
sources.identifier: IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications, 2025
sources.novelty_effect: Broad claims to be the first GRAND mechanism operating at the modulation interface are unsafe.
sources.technical_relevance: Uses GRAND as part of demodulation rather than only a post-demapper bit decoder.
sources.title: GRAND-Assisted Demodulation
